name: ssh-tools
description: External ssh CONSUMER: exposes the ssh transport (ssh@1) as the tools ssh_run, ssh_status, ssh_copy_to and ssh_copy_from - provider agnostic, it only touches ctx.ssh. host is a required per-call parameter; the key is a credential NAME.

privateKeyName.description: Credential NAME used when a tool call passes no `credential` parameter. NEVER a path and NEVER a value.

configFilePath.description: ssh config file passed as -F <path> on every call.

maxCopyBytes.description: Transfer bound for ssh_copy_to / ssh_copy_from in bytes (hard cap 65536; base64 must fit one argv element).
